# `skillset dev`

> Generated from Skillset's CLI presentation contract. See the [documentation system](../../development/documentation-system.md).

Watch source and continuously preview or write changes.

## Usage

```text
skillset dev [--write] [--jsonl] [--root <path>]
```

## Options

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--jsonl` | Emit a versioned newline-delimited event stream. |
| `--root <value>` | Select the repository root; defaults to cwd or Git root according to the route. |
| `--write` | Enable deterministic ordinary output writes for a route whose default is continuous or comprehensive preview. |
